title: NYAB Q3'26: Orderrekord, nu måste vinsterna hänga med
summary_md:
# NYAB Q3'26: Orderrekord, nu måste vinsterna hänga med

**Feed**: inderes-se  
**Published**: 2026-11-11  
**Market Sentiment**: Positive

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

In this Inderes TV episode, the host talks with Inderes analyst Christoffer about NYAB's Q3'26 report. The company booked record order intake of EUR 545m, revenue grew 27% and Finland grew about 120-130% year on year, driven by the Mikkeli data-centre contract. Adjusted margins came in slightly below estimates because of ramp-up costs and a weak consulting unit (Dovre), and the 7.5% EBIT margin target has been pushed out two years. Inderes raised its target price but cut its rating from buy to accumulate ('öka') after the share's strong run, while staying positive on the stock.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 NYAB — NYAB | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Inderes analyst cuts rating from buy to accumulate ('öka') and raises target price; still sees it as an attractive stock to own

#### Reasoning

Cited analyst view (Inderes, Christoffer). Record order intake and a backlog up about 16% give good visibility, especially in Finland through 2027 thanks to the Mikkeli data-centre contract plus a second data-centre contract in Utajärvi. Adjusted margins missed because of ramp-up costs, a weak Dovre consulting unit and a non-operational boost from the option-hedge instrument. The share is up strongly (about 10% since early October), so upside to target is smaller, hence accumulate rather than bu

#### Sell Triggers

- if margins fail to follow revenue growth over coming quarters
- if execution problems hit a large project (cost overruns, input cost inflation)
- if recruitment/subcontractor bottlenecks constrain backlog conversion
- if consulting segment keeps diluting and the 7.5% EBIT target slips further
- if share price rises further and erodes upside to target

> *"Vi tycker fortfarande att det är ett attraktivt läge att äga Nyab. Men vi väljer att justera ner vår rekommendation till öka istället för köp."*
